game_concept: A racing platformer set in Snowy Hold – Hearth Hall, a warm hearth hall: the frost mage must handle frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against frozen golems.
theme: Snowy Hold – Hearth Hall: a warm hearth hall
core_gameplay_loop: In Hearth Hall, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against frozen golems. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the frost mage ahead. Then check the spells value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the hearth fire by solving code steps involving spells that move the frost mage forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.6).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the hearth fire first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Hearth Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frozen golems in Hearth Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.6).
